newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ arranges securitisation for Pacific Retail.
newsitem.headline: BNZ arranges securitisation for Pacific Retail.

text.p: Bank of New Zealand said on Tuesday it had arranged a securitisation of consumer receivables originated by Pacific Retail Group Ltd with a first issue to the investor market on January 24.

The special purpose securitisation company, Pacific Retail Securities Ltd, will be funded by a mixture of subordinated debt and registered notes. The latter will be issued under a NZ$250 million asset-backed commercial paper programme and are rated A-1+ by Standard and Poor's and Prime-1 by Moody's.

Back-up liquidity to the note programme will be provided by a consortium made up of BNZ, ASB Bank and Societe Generale Australia. A financial guarantee has been provided by U.S. group Financial Security Assurance.
Pacific Retail, formerly Noel Leeming, is New Zealand's biggest retailer of home appliances and consumer electronics.
